headlines.title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
headlines.summary: UNH is the biggest name in managed care and a Dow component — when it beats and raises, the whole healthcare sector gets a bid. A hike to at least $20.50 EPS guidance is the kind of print that moves the tape on insurers, hospitals, and pharmacy benefit managers alike. This is the real deal, not a whisper number.

headlines.title: Micron, SoftBank and ASML slide as Wall Street chip rout spreads
headlines.summary: A chip selloff that jumps continents — from Seoul to Amsterdam to New York — is not a one-day blip, it's a sector rotation story with real teeth. Semis are the engine of the AI trade, so when Micron, ASML, and SoftBank all get hit simultaneously, the Nasdaq feels it in the gut. Watch the SOX index; if it can't hold support, the broader market narrative gets a lot messier.

headlines.title: Iran reportedly fortifies nuclear sites as it prepares for possible U.S. strikes after midterms
headlines.summary: Riyadh airport attacks, Houthi missiles, Iran hardening nuclear sites — this is a full-blown Middle East escalation story that puts a floor under oil and a ceiling on risk appetite. Airlines, defense names, and energy stocks all move on this; the FAA warning over Saudi airspace alone is a direct hit to carriers with Gulf exposure. Geopolitical risk premiums don't price themselves.
